name: Opus Clip
summary: Opus Clip harnesses AI to repurpose long videos into viral short clips, auto-selecting the most engaging segments for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts.
description:
Opus Clip harnesses AI to repurpose long videos into viral short clips, auto-selecting the most engaging segments for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts.

OpusClip turns long videos into high-quality viral clips, and publishes them to all social platforms in one click. We help 20M+ creators create and grow faster.

Viral moment detection: AI analyzes videos to identify and extract the most engaging, shareable moments. Auto captions: Automatically adds animated, visually appealing captions to increase watch time and accessibility. Highlight reels: Generates multiple short clips from a single long video, maximizing content value. Platform optimization: Exports clips in formats tailored for TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Instagram Reels.

howToUse.title: Sign Up and Log In
howToUse.description: Go to Opus Clip's website and create an account. Log into your dashboard to start a new project.

howToUse.title: Upload Your Source Video
howToUse.description: Click 'Upload' and select the long-form video you want to repurpose. Opus Clip supports a variety of file types.

howToUse.title: Select Output Platform
howToUse.description: Choose the social platform you want to optimize for (e.g., TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels). The tool will recommend the best format.

howToUse.title: Run AI Viral Clip Detection
howToUse.description: Let Opus Clip automatically scan your video for the most engaging and shareable moments, generating a handful of short clips.

howToUse.title: Edit Clips and Add Captions
howToUse.description: Use the built-in editor to tweak each clip, add animated captions, branding, overlays, or adjust timing and transitions.

howToUse.title: Review and Export
howToUse.description: Preview all generated clips, make final adjustments, then export as MP4 or share directly to your social platforms.

howToUse.title: Analyze and Batch Process
howToUse.description: Use analytics tools to see which clips perform best. If needed, use Opus Clip’s batch mode for processing multiple videos at once.
